idea-plugin.name: Code Colorizer
idea-plugin.description:
Easily change the color of every code element:
  • Colorizer tool window: every colorable element of each language (keywords, strings, comments, methods, fields, annotations...), with text color, background, bold, italic and underline.
  • Right-click in the editor → Change Color of This Element: automatically finds what colors the code under the caret.
  • Pick an element in the IDE button: click some code, a line number, the gutter... in the editor to show it in the list and change its color.
  • 8 preset themes (Purple & Green, Neon Pink & Mint, Blue & Turquoise, Amber & Sage, Orange & Gold, Yellow & Neon Green, Burgundy & Green, Magenta & Soft Blue) applied in one click; they keep your IDE theme's background and line numbers.
  • Import / export themes as JSON to share or back them up.
  • Changes apply live and are saved per color scheme.

action.description: Change the color of the code element under the caret
